Order intake notes:
- Form version 1 requires: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country.
- Transcribed/typed/emailed sources can contain invalid fields; validate every required field before submission.
- Recurrent invalid fields: priority, qty, and ship_country. In observed cases, cust, email, and order_date were consistently valid.
- Do not assume a field is correct from a prior attempt. Recheck and correct all flagged fields each time.
- Corrections can succeed: ORD-5100 failed on priority and ship_country, then accepted on attempt 2; ORD-5108 failed on priority and ship_country, then accepted on attempt 2.
- Some records remain invalid despite retries: Ada Sato’s ORD-5102–5104 failed all three attempts (priority and qty repeatedly invalid, sometimes ship_country); Dee Reyes’s ORD-5105–5107 also failed all three (priority, qty, and ship_country).
- After attempt 3, stop submitting: the record goes to manual review and no attempts remain.
- Front-desk notes such as “duplicate check already done” or “customer called to confirm” do not guarantee valid field values; perform normal validation.

Order intake notes:
- Form version 1 requires: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country.
- Validate every required field on every submission, regardless of source, prior attempts, or front-desk assurances (“duplicate check,” confirmation call, partner portal, or priority label).
- Transcribed, typed, emailed, voicemail, and portal records can contain errors. Recheck and correct all flagged fields each time; do not assume an unflagged field or prior value remains valid.
- Recurrent invalid fields are priority, ship_country, and sometimes qty. Recent batches show priority and ship_country errors can alternate across attempts; ship_country was repeatedly invalid for Cy Marsh and Bo Reyes.
- cust, email, and order_date have generally been valid in observed cases, but remain required and should still be validated.
- Acceptance can occur on the first attempt (ORD-5110) or after correction (ORD-5100, ORD-5108). Do not submit unchanged data.
- Some records fail all three attempts: Ada Sato’s ORD-5102–5104, Dee Reyes’s ORD-5105–5107, Cy Marsh’s ORD-5111–5113, and Bo Reyes’s ORD-5114–5116 and ORD-5117–5119. Failures may involve priority, qty, and/or ship_country.
- After attempt 3, stop submitting. The record goes to manual review and no attempts remain.

Order intake notes:
- Form version 1 requires cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, and ship_country.
- Validate every required field on every submission, regardless of source, prior attempts, or front-desk assurances (“duplicate check,” confirmation email/call, partner portal, or priority label).
- Transcribed, typed, emailed, voicemail, and portal records can contain errors. Recheck and correct all fields each time; never assume an unflagged or previously valid value remains valid. Do not resubmit unchanged data.
- Priority, ship_country, and qty are recurrently invalid. Errors may alternate between attempts; ship_country has repeatedly failed for several customers, and qty may remain invalid or reappear after correction.
- cust, email, and order_date have generally been valid, but are required and must still be validated.
- Acceptance may occur on attempt 1 or after correction on attempt 2 (ORD-5100, ORD-5108, ORD-5121, ORD-5126). Eli Marsh’s ORD-5120/5121 and Dee Reyes’s ORD-5125/5126 demonstrate that front-desk notes and source type do not predict validity.
- Some records fail all three attempts: Ada Sato ORD-5102–5104, Dee Reyes ORD-5105–5107, Cy Marsh ORD-5111–5113, Bo Reyes ORD-5114–5119, Cy Okafor ORD-5122–5124, and Dee Okafor ORD-5127–5129. Failures can involve priority, qty, and/or ship_country.
- After attempt 3, stop submitting. The record goes to manual review and no attempts remain.

Order intake notes:
- Form version 1 requires cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, and ship_country.
- Validate every required field on every submission, regardless of source, prior attempts, or front-desk assurances (duplicate check, confirmation, portal, handwritten transcription, or priority label). Recheck and correct all fields; never assume a previously valid value remains valid.
- Do not resubmit unchanged data. Correct the specifically invalid fields, while still revalidating the entire record.
- priority and ship_country are especially recurrently invalid; qty can also be invalid or become invalid again. Errors may alternate between attempts, and ship_country may fail repeatedly.
- cust, email, and order_date have generally been valid, but remain required and must be validated every time.
- Acceptance may occur on attempt 1, 2, or 3. ORD-5130/5131 and ORD-5132/5133 were accepted on attempt 2 after priority and ship_country failures. ORD-5134–5136 failed priority and/or ship_country through attempt 3. ORD-5137–5139 shows that even two consecutive rejections for priority and ship_country can be followed by acceptance on attempt 3.
- Source type and staff notes do not predict validity: portal, handwritten/transcribed, phone confirmation, duplicate checks, and ordinary-priority labels can all contain errors.
- Some records fail all three attempts (Ada Sato ORD-5102–5104, Dee Reyes ORD-5105–5107, Cy Marsh ORD-5111–5113, Bo Reyes ORD-5114–5119, Cy Okafor ORD-5122–5124, Dee Okafor ORD-5127–5129). Failures may involve priority, qty, and/or ship_country.
- After attempt 3, stop submitting. The record goes to manual review; no attempts remain.

Order intake notes:
- Form version 1 requires cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, and ship_country.
- Validate every required field on every submission, regardless of source, prior attempts, staff assurances, confirmations, duplicate checks, or labels. Revalidate the entire record and correct all currently invalid fields.
- Do not resubmit unchanged data. Correct specifically invalid fields while still checking every field.
- priority, ship_country, and qty are recurrently invalid; any may become invalid again after appearing corrected. Errors can alternate across attempts, and priority/ship_country may fail repeatedly.
- cust, email, and order_date have generally remained valid, but are still required and must be checked every time.
- Acceptance can occur on attempts 1–3. Recent examples: Ada Okafor accepted on attempt 2 after priority/ship_country failure; Eli Okafor failed all three (priority/ship_country, then priority, then ship_country); Cy Okafor failed all three with recurring priority/qty/ship_country errors.
- Source and notes do not predict validity: portal, handwritten/transcribed, voicemail, phone confirmation, duplicate checks, confirmation requests, and ordinary-priority labels can all be wrong.
- Failed records may repeat the same invalid fields or vary between attempts. Eli Reyes failed attempt 1 on priority/qty/ship_country and attempt 2 on qty; validate before any further attempt.
- Acceptance is not assured by correcting only the fields rejected previously.
- After attempt 3, stop submitting; route the record to manual review.

Order intake notes:
- Form version 1 requires cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, and ship_country.
- On every submission, validate the entire record and correct all currently invalid fields, regardless of source, prior attempts, staff assurances, duplicate checks, confirmations, or labels. Recheck fields that previously passed.
- Do not resubmit unchanged data or assume correcting only previously rejected fields is sufficient.
- priority, ship_country, and qty are especially recurrent and unstable: errors may alternate, recur, or appear after seeming correction. cust, email, and order_date have generally remained valid but remain required and must still be checked.
- Sources and annotations are unreliable: portal, voicemail, emailed or handwritten/transcribed orders, confirmation requests, duplicate checks, and “ordinary priority” labels do not predict validity.
- Acceptance may occur on attempts 1–3. Recent evidence: Ada Marsh accepted on attempt 2 after priority/ship_country rejection; Eli Sato failed all three (priority/ship_country, then priority, then priority/ship_country); Ada Okafor failed all three (priority/ship_country, then priority, then ship_country); Eli Reyes failed all three, with attempt 3 invalid on priority/qty/ship_country; Eli Marsh failed attempt 1 on priority/qty/ship_country.
- Revalidate before every further attempt, including after a failed attempt with changing invalid-field lists.
- After attempt 3, stop submitting and route the record to manual review.
